t: The Hermit-Crab AI Strategy: Navigating Free-Tier Intelligence as a Service
s: This article explores Google's strategy of offering free-tier Intelligence as a Service (IaaS) to capture market share and drive ecosystem lock-in, contrasting it with the vision of local AI. It proposes leveraging cloud AI as a 'hot-swappable' subcontractor to local 'hermit-crab' AI for pragmatic future-proofing.
sub: Google's free-tier IaaS strategy for market capture and ecosystem lock-in.
The 'Hermit-Crab' AI concept: local AI augmented by cloud subcontractors.
AI as a service (IaaS) as a new cloud paradigm, superseding infrastructure as a service.
The role of data as R&D and developer evangelism in cloud AI adoption.
Comparison of cloud AI strategies (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic) and their implications.
